recorded_execution_scope: The NPZ actions are the commands submitted to env.step, not measured wheel angle/force after MetaDrive processing. Exact matching certifies submission, not a physical-response measurement.
candidate_scope: Catalog candidates are already bounded post-MPPI sequences. Pre-clipping Gaussian draws were not archived, so clipping provenance cannot be reconstructed.
action_order_static_audit: base_vehicle._set_action: action[0] steering, action[1] throttle/brake. _preprocess_action clips to [-1,1]. before_step currently uses _set_action, not incremental steering.
steering_mapping: steering_command * vehicle.max_steering; actual branch-specific max_steering/wheel angles not saved.
throttle_mapping: positive engine force with speed cap; negative with enable_reverse=False is brake force; not a linear SI acceleration mapping.
runtime_dimension_or_sign_verification: Current source supports channel order; prior per-step actual vehicle controls were not recorded, so no claim of complete runtime SI mapping verification.
